key.problem.unreadable: The stored API key file could not be read, so it was left as it is.

settings.chatModelHelp: Reads the conversation, answers and decides when to make or change an image.
settings.contentFontHelp: Used for messages and replies, as a CSS font list.
settings.error.choice: Choose one of the offered values.
settings.error.lineHeight: Use a line height from 1.2 to 2.
settings.error.timeZone: This time zone is not known.
settings.imageModelHelp: Makes and edits the images the assistant asks for.
settings.keyFromEnv: OPENAI_API_KEY is set in the environment, so it is used instead of the key here.
settings.keyHelp: Stored in GptImg's own folder, readable only by you. Clear the field to remove it.
settings.openaiOnly: GptImg works with OpenAI only; requests are billed to this key's account.

settings.thinkingHelp: How much the assistant reasons before answering. More is slower and uses more tokens.

settings.unsupportedModel: This model is not supported and may not work as expected.
setup.folderBody: Each chat is saved as a folder here, with every message, image and attached file, so it can be reopened and continued at any time.
setup.intro: GptImg makes images with your own OpenAI account; each message is billed to it.
setup.keyFromEnv: OPENAI_API_KEY is set in the environment, so GptImg will use it. You can still store a key later in Settings.
setup.keyHelp: Create one at platform.openai.com. It is stored in GptImg's own folder, readable only by you.
